# D E2 Allocation Envelope P04
Status: PASS_ISOLATED_CANDIDATE_ONLY. Formal interface/schema/release NOT_APPROVED.

## Implemented shape
allocation_envelope.py is new; Core and P02 modules are exact verified copies. No original code edited and no A40/D-stage composition. E1/E3/E4 remain existing Core.
Wire proposal d-e2-allocation/0.1-proposed. Strict frozen Pydantic models: Binding, SourceRef, Allocation, Candidate, Trial, Envelope, extra=forbid. Typed allocations hold equipment_id/sample_count; candidates hold trial_id, required_devices/requested_quantity, proposal ordinal/ID, full original proposal and digest. Each trial retains original Request/Result and source refs, request/result digests, source validity and structured refusal reasons. Root original_record retains all original sidecars/context/version relations and fingerprint/record digest. Empty proposal trials keep identity, original request/result and source refs. Truly empty trial lists keep original_record and INDETERMINATE; no fake trial ID is invented. Missing result uses explicit None slot, not fabricated output.

## Binding source — exact seven-field engineering shape
Verified B-P04 source/candidate/profiles.py lines 50-63 defines:
jobId:str; attemptId:str; snapshotId:str; snapshotRevision:str; sourceRevision:str; fenceToken:str; executionEpoch:int.
Six strings remain byte-content-preserving (no trimming/coercion); epoch stays integer and preserves B checked range 1..9007199254740991; bool/float/string coercion rejected. This range reuses B's candidate check, not a new policy decision. B explicitly labels this INTERNAL engineering shape, NOT approved seven-field wire Schema. Names/types copied from that evidence, not guessed from C. C 0.2.2 remains unchanged; no claim of approved C Binding Schema.
build() requires caller-supplied Binding. decode(raw,expected_binding=...) compares exact full independently expected seven fields; wrong expected fence/attempt rejected. Structural validity is not authentication, source authority or a durable fence. No B IDs, revision or executionEpoch is issued by D. Formal B trusted Binding/source/authorization remains unavailable; only synthetic outputs admitted, public projection always BLOCKED.

## Serialization and identities — PROPOSED only
Canonical profile SHA256_PY_JSON_SORTED_UTF8_COMPACT_V1_PROPOSED: Python json.dumps(sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False).encode('utf-8'). No Unicode normalization or sorting of semantic arrays. Python float rendering is retained; this is NOT RFC8785/JCS or a cross-language formal standard. No Decimal default=float coercion is allowed. Source JSON numbers preserved; inherited exact-native decimal admission remains unchanged. Numeric profile beyond verified fixture values is still a contract decision.
Envelope digest excludes only its own digest field and includes binding, version, source, trial and original evidence. Native request/result/proposal digests use existing ai_engine_core.models.digest exactly; record fingerprint/digest use existing registry profile, named separately. candidate_id is SHA256 of canonical {binding,record_fingerprint,record_digest,trial_index,trial_id,proposal_index,proposal_digest}; indexes refer to preserved ordered native proposals. No cross-attempt identity collapse. It is replay-stable for identical ordered sources; candidate reordering changes identity. Order-independent identity, public dedup and retention remain unresolved policies.
raw_bytes_sha accepts only bytes. Canonical JSON hashes are NOT original-file byte hashes, authorization signatures or trusted measurement evidence. A correctly resealed attacker document is not authenticated. Outer frozen models contain mutable raw-evidence dicts, so encode() and decode() both fully revalidate, not rely on frozen containers alone. Duplicate JSON keys, NaN, bad digest and version fail closed.

## Semantic guards
Reuse P02 capture validation and existing quality.sources/capacity guards. Check source catalog identity/current synthetic state, capacity evidence presence and synthetic L/fixture envelope/count/configuration/availability; stale/revoked/version-mismatched sources and missing physical evidence produce REFUSED with empty candidates and original evidence preserved. No formal physical placement or source trust claim is made. Missing sources/status cannot be bypassed by resealing a digest. Unknown or malformed fields raise validation errors, never fall back to a public success.
Keep all native allocations/proposals, including unequal multi-device counts. Validate positive strict integer sample_count, unique devices, demand totals and device requirement, request/result/source identities/digests, DAY and per-trial dates. No new scheduling algorithm, quantity defaults, Space Unit/L conversion, partial-day rule, geometric proof or unsafe capacity relaxation. sampleVolumeLitres means traceable sample+fixture physical envelope L, usableVolumeLitres equipment usable L, capacity count limit, separate from Space Unit.
ADVISORY means only synthetic internal rule candidates. INDETERMINATE for empty domains/proposals or incomplete trial analysis; REFUSED for missing/invalid sources/results. None is a new public Job enum. No FULL_ENUMERATION; no NO_FEASIBLE_SCHEDULE projection; no ProviderAdvice/C DTO expansion. No Reservation, publication, state transition, billing, Provider, SQL or integration call.
